    scope = character # Player Character

    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_building_or_higher = castle_01 }

                    limit = {

    effect = {

DI_tm_building_legendary_shrine_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = legendary_shrine }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = legendary_shrine
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = legendary_shrine
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_building_legendary_palace_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = legendary_palace }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = legendary_palace
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = legendary_palace
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = fire_court_01 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = fire_court_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = fire_court_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = fire_court_02 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = fire_court_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = fire_court_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = fire_court_03 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = fire_court_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = fire_court_03
                }
            }

    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = paris_01 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = paris_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = paris_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = paris_02 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = paris_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = paris_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = paris_03 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = paris_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = paris_03
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_destroy_building_paris_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building = paris_03 } remove_building = paris_03 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = paris_02 } remove_building = paris_02 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = paris_01 } remove_building = paris_01 }
            }
        }
    }
}

                    if = {

                        add_special_building_slot = holy_site_canterbury_cathedral_01

DI_tm_building_generic_university_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = generic_university }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = generic_university
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = generic_university
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = changan_market_01 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = changan_market_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = changan_market_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = changan_market_02 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = changan_market_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = changan_market_02
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_building_temple_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_building_or_higher = temple_01 }
                    }
                    set_holding_type = church_holding
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_01 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_02 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_03 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_03
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4 }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_04 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_04
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_destroy_building_temple_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building = temple_04 } remove_building = temple_04 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = temple_03 } remove_building = temple_03 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = temple_02 } remove_building = temple_02 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = temple_01 } remove_building = temple_01 }
            }
        }
    }
}

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                DI_remove_building_type_effect = { BUILDING = monastic_schools }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_building_megalith_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 5
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 6
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 7
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 8
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = megalith_01 }
                    }
                    add_building = megalith_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = megalith_02 }
                    }
                    add_building = megalith_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = megalith_03 }
                    }
                    add_building = megalith_03
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4 }
                        NOT = { has_building = megalith_04 }
                    }
                    add_building = megalith_04
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 5 }
                        NOT = { has_building = megalith_05 }
                    }
                    add_building = megalith_05
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 6 }
                        NOT = { has_building = megalith_06 }
                    }
                    add_building = megalith_06
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 7 }
                        NOT = { has_building = megalith_07 }
                    }
                    add_building = megalith_07
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 8 }
                        NOT = { has_building = megalith_08 }
                    }
                    add_building = megalith_08
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_destroy_building_megalith_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                DI_remove_building_type_effect = { BUILDING = megalith }
            }
        }
    }

DI_tm_building_tribe_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_building_or_higher = tribe_01 }
                    }
                    set_holding_type = tribal_holding
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = tribe_01 }
                    }
                    add_building = tribe_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = tribe_02 }
                    }
                    add_building = tribe_02
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_destroy_building_tribe_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building = tribe_02 } remove_building = tribe_02 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = tribe_01 } remove_building = tribe_01 }
            }
        }
    }
}

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = kano_walls_01 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = kano_walls_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = kano_walls_01
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_destroy_building_kano_walls_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building = kano_walls_01 } remove_building = kano_walls_01 }
            }
        }
    }
}

    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {

            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }

                        add_special_building_slot = duomo_florence_01

                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = duomo_florence_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = duomo_florence_02 }

                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = duomo_florence_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = duomo_florence_02

                else_if = {

                        NOT = { has_building = duomo_florence_03 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = duomo_florence_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = duomo_florence_03
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4 }
                        NOT = { has_building = duomo_florence_04 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = duomo_florence_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = duomo_florence_04
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = feline_law_01 }
                    }
                    add_building = feline_law_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = feline_law_02 }
                    }
                    add_building = feline_law_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = feline_law_03 }
                    }
                    add_building = feline_law_03
                }
            }
        }

                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = constantinople_plundered_constantinople_03 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }

            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
        }

        save_scope_as = player

                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }

                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = constantinople_rebuild_constantinople_01

                    add_special_building = constantinople_rebuild_constantinople_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = constantinople_rebuild_constantinople_02 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = constantinople_rebuild_constantinople_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = constantinople_rebuild_constantinople_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = constantinople_rebuild_constantinople_03 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = constantinople_rebuild_constantinople_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = constantinople_rebuild_constantinople_03
                }
            }
        }
    }

                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = constantinople_reform_constantinople_02 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = constantinople_reform_constantinople_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = constantinople_reform_constantinople_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = constantinople_reform_constantinople_03 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = constantinople_reform_constantinople_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = constantinople_reform_constantinople_03
                }

DI_tm_building_grand_city_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_building_or_higher = grand_city_01 }
                    }
                    set_holding_type = grand_city_holding
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = grand_city_01 }
                    }
                    add_building = grand_city_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = grand_city_02 }
                    }
                    add_building = grand_city_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = grand_city_03 }
                    }
                    add_building = grand_city_03
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4 }
                        NOT = { has_building = grand_city_04 }
                    }
                    add_building = grand_city_04
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_destroy_building_grand_city_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building = grand_city_04 } remove_building = grand_city_04 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = grand_city_03 } remove_building = grand_city_03 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = grand_city_02 } remove_building = grand_city_02 }

            }
        }

        }

                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }

                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }

                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = paris_chivalric_02 }

                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }

                    }

                    add_special_building = paris_chivalric_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = paris_chivalric_03 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = paris_chivalric_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = paris_chivalric_03

            }
        }

                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = rome_st_peters_city_01 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = rome_st_peters_city_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = rome_st_peters_city_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = rome_st_peters_city_02 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = rome_st_peters_city_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = rome_st_peters_city_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = rome_st_peters_city_03 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = rome_st_peters_city_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = rome_st_peters_city_03
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = patroned_temple_01 }
                    }
                    add_building = patroned_temple_01
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {

            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2

                if = {

                    set_holding_type = temple_citadel_holding
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_citadel_01 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_citadel_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_citadel_02 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_citadel_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_citadel_03 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_citadel_03
                }
